name: FTSE 100
summary: FTSE 100 closed at 10,453 on 19 Nov, 4.2% below its high and 4.1% lower on the week; no daily fall above 2.5%
state: The FTSE 100 closed near 10,453 on 19 Nov, 4.1% lower on the week and 4.2% below its 52-week high of 10,911 (Yahoo Finance). Its largest daily fall of the past five sessions was 1.8%, inside the 2.5% single-day Watch line, and the drawdown is just inside the 5% line. Risk is rising with the global equity sell-off of 17–19 Nov.
for_you: UK-listed shares have fallen with global markets but remain within normal ranges. Pension funds with UK equity exposure have seen modest losses over the week.
